: Squashed into #73512: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/pldm/+/73512

Since switched to use std approach, it is no longer needed to be a seperate patch.

For reviewers,
This MR will needs openssl as dependency to be available, therefore the feature has been made configurable by meson option, there is another [patch] for openbmc/openbmc for adding openssl as dependency.

[patch]: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openbmc/+/78797
@unive.tien.wiwynn@gmail.com This is not an optional feature. Please drop the meson option and always include the id as a suffix to the path.

I don't understand what the point of this is.  Why don't we use the same hash method that we use everywhere else (from std)??  Adding a dependency on openssl just to perform a single 8 character hash seems absurd at first glance.
Why is this?
Why is this an optional feature? Maybe more detailed are requred in the commit message.
Why are we disabling by default?  That means we have _more_ code that isn't being tested in CI.
